=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/evidence_pack.py:95-97 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `GH_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 1` comment says "a build sends at most 4 requests and never sleeps on a retry or rate limit". The agents.d/8427-p4-persist-evidence-pack.md line 9 API budget bullet makes the same claim. The request bound is wrong: on a rate-limited read with no wait hint, gh_api_retry.call (scripts/gh_api_retry.py:446-455) calls `_rate_limit_reset(eff_bucket, runner)` (line 450). That sends one more `gh api rate_limit` request before the `attempt >= total` give-up, so a degraded build can send up to 6 requests.
  WHY: Both reviewers rated this NIT. The "never sleeps" part is correct and the breaker suppresses later calls, so nothing breaks at runtime. Still, the contractual agents text and the code comment overstate the bound the plan sets ("API: at most 4 calls per build", docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:431).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Plan: the same, plus the previous plan's `## Files likely to change` when re-planning." (P4 step 2, docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md line 434). Linked issue #8518 says "do not shrink P4's scope" and does not defer this item.
  expected_change_site: scripts/run_plan_codex.sh, the evidence-pack block (lines 353-367). The previous plan's file list should be passed as a trusted `--plan-file` / `--paths-file` next to `--text-file "${PLANNING_CONTEXT_FILE}"`.
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The plan-path invocation passes only `--text-file "${PLANNING_CONTEXT_FILE}"` (scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:357-360). collect_paths (scripts/evidence_pack.py:247-283) treats `--text-file` as untrusted: it takes the last Files-likely-to-change section from any commenter and keeps only existing tracked files (`safe_rel_path` without `allow_missing`, then `_tracked`). So files the previous plan would create are dropped from the open-PR overlap check, and the section used may come from a later non-pipeline comment. No hunk in the PR diff or the last-run diff reads a pipeline-authored previous plan for the plan phase. A prior autofix editor recorded TASK_GAP_DEFERRED, but the issue states no deferral. The last run added `timeout 300` to this block and left the gap in place. Severity disagreement: NIT per sonnet, luna and glm; BLOCKER per gemini.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- agents.d/8427-p4-persist-evidence-pack.md:9 (also scripts/evidence_pack.py line 95) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The text "`max_attempts=1` per read, so a build sends at most 4 requests and never sleeps on a retry or rate limit" is not quite true. In scripts/gh_api_retry.py, `call()` (lines 446-455) handles a rate limit before it checks `attempt >= total`. With `cls.wait_secs < 0` it calls `_rate_limit_reset(eff_bucket, runner)` (line 450, lines 377-389), which sends one extra `gh api rate_limit` request, so a rate-limited read sends 2 requests.
  WHY: Nothing breaks: `rate_limit` is free and the breaker trip skips later reads. But the contractual text promises a hard request bound the code does not keep. Suggested fix: "at most 4 API reads (plus gh_api_retry's free `rate_limit` lookup on a rate-limited read), never sleeping".
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md line 434 (P4 step 2, Paths): "Plan: the same, plus the previous plan's `## Files likely to change` when re-planning." Issue #8518 does not defer it; only the previous editor summary did (TASK_GAP_DEFERRED).
  Expected change site: scripts/run_plan_codex.sh, the evidence-pack block (lines 353-367). Pass the previous pipeline-authored plan as a trusted `--plan-file` or `--paths-file`; `collect_paths` already supports `allow_missing=True`.
  Evidence of absence: The call passes only `--text-file "${PLANNING_CONTEXT_FILE}"`, which is untrusted (last section from any commenter; `safe_rel_path` without `allow_missing`, then `_tracked`). Files the previous plan would create never reach the overlap check, and the section may come from a later non-pipeline comment. No hunk reads a previous plan. The last run added `timeout 300` and left the gap in place.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING: scripts/evidence_pack.py `main()` before `cmd_build(args, builder)`, together with `finally: _git(root, ["update-ref", "-d", HISTORY_REF])` in `Builder.history`. `timeout 300` (scripts/run_plan_codex.sh line 360) and `timeout-minutes: 5` stop the build with SIGTERM. The default handler skips `finally`, so `refs/persist/history` is left behind (cosmetic: the next fetch force-updates it). Fix: `import signal` plus `signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, lambda *_: sys.exit(143))`. Estimated lines: 2. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Unmapped signal, not raised as a finding: the pre-push gate lists tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py as "caused by this change". That file mentions `docs/INVENTORY.md` only in fixture data (lines 3417, 3429, 3573), and no hunk touches anything the test runs. The check runs show `failed_count: 0` (`collection_status: timeout`).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

No hunk reads a pipeline-authored previous plan. The prior editor's TASK_GAP_DEFERRED is not stated in the issue.
